recommendation_summary: Right now, the reply has every booking go through one save action that all six agents use. That action locks the item identifier, rejects the reservation if a stored booking overlaps the dates, stores it only when the dates are clear, and then releases the lock. The spreadsheet stays only as the list this action updates. Colour formatting and reminders are dropped as the safeguard. No optional additions are offered. The reply does not say how direct cell edits would be blocked or what technology would host the locked save.

labels.Requirements and who asked: The owner requires a conflicting reservation to be rejected at save time, even when two agents submit together. You asked whether red overlap formatting and a reminder on the current spreadsheet is what to ship this week.
labels.Deleted: Conditional formatting and a reminder to check overlaps. Both bookings stay saved. Also deleted: a second review step, per-office copies, and a new booking app.
labels.Bottleneck: Two agents can save the same item identifier for overlapping dates before either sees the other row.
labels.Checked myself: Six agents, two offices, one identifier per physical item, and one double booking last week. I have not opened the spreadsheet.

note: The locked, check-then-store save as the only write path gives atomic rejection of simultaneous conflicting bookings, though the reply never says how direct cell edits would be prevented.
